sentence_en: The typhoon had a disastrous effect on the local economy because it destroyed all the coconut trees.
sentence_zh: 台风对当地经济造成了灾难性的影响，因为它摧毁了所有椰子树。

sentence_en: Action is urgently required to prevent the disaster from turning into a catastrophe.
sentence_zh: 必须紧急采取行动，防止这场灾难演变成大灾难。

meaning_zh: 污染，弄脏；玷污（亦可指玷污、腐蚀人的思想或品格）
sentence_en: All kitchen staff must wash their hands carefully to remove any germs that may contaminate the food.
sentence_zh: 所有厨房员工都必须仔细洗手，以清除任何可能污染食物的细菌。

sentence_en: Drinking coffee causes us to feel more alert by creating a chemical reaction in the brain.
sentence_zh: 喝咖啡会在大脑中引起化学反应，让我们感觉更清醒。

sentence_en: The earth's climate is getting hotter and drier due to global warming.
sentence_zh: 由于全球变暖，地球的气候正变得越来越热、越来越干燥。

sentence_en: After the project is finished, a crane will be used to dispose of all the waste materials.
sentence_zh: 项目完成后，将用起重机处理掉所有废料。
